_comment: Topic-specific categories. Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order).

categories.name: Deposit withheld or deducted
categories.description: Deposits withheld, unfair deductions, deposits not protected.

categories.name: Repairs, damp & mould ignored
categories.description: Landlords ignoring repairs, damp, mould, leaks, pests, heating.

categories.name: Broker, agent & application fees
categories.description: Brokerage, letting/agent fees, holding deposits, application fees.
keywords: broker|brokerage|agent fee|letting fee|application fee|holding deposit|admin fee

categories.name: Eviction & notice to leave
categories.description: Evictions, no-fault notices, sudden demands to vacate.

categories.name: Finding a place & competition
categories.description: Few listings, bidding wars, fake listings, viewing scrambles.

categories.name: Restrictive rules & discrimination
categories.description: No bachelors, pets, food or religion rules, guarantor and income checks.
keywords: bachelor|no pets|\bpets?\b|vegetarian only|family only|discriminat|guarantor|credit check|income requirement

categories.name: Landlord harassment & entry
categories.description: Landlords entering without notice, threats, lock-outs.

categories.name: Lease & rental agreements
categories.description: Agreement terms, registration, break clauses, renewals.

categories.name: Utilities & society/service charges
categories.description: Maintenance and society fees, utility bills, water supply.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: Landlord
keywords: my tenant|as a landlord|i('m| am) a landlord
